# WIIIUI Forever — 1.1.0

### Bring the Warcraft III command console into World of Warcraft: Forever.

**Four faction-inspired interfaces. Animated character portraits. A customizable HUD. One familiar Warcraft III feeling.**

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.1.0-brightgreen)](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever)
[![Client](https://img.shields.io/badge/client-WoW%20Forever-blue)](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever)
[![Interface](https://img.shields.io/badge/interface-16001-informational)](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever)
[![Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever)](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/issues)

WIIIUI Forever reimagines [Fiur's original WIIIUI](https://github.com/Fiurs-Hearth/WIIIUI) for the **WoW Forever** client. It frames WoW's native controls in Warcraft III-inspired faction consoles, adds practical customization, and gives your character screen a classic strategy-game look.

> **1.1.0 — Talents and healing feedback.** Made for **Forever 1.60.1.71139 / Interface 16001**. Other WoW clients are **not** currently supported or tested. Contributions and bug reports are welcome.

**[Download 1.1.0](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/releases/download/v1.1.0/WIIIUIForever-1.1.0.zip)** · **[Release notes](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/blob/main/docs/RELEASE-NOTES-1.1.0.md)**

1.1.0 adds point allocation in the Character window's talent trees, cyan incoming-healing previews, and floating healing-received numbers. It includes the four faction themes, movable windows, customizable HUD, Soul Shard tracking, fitted quick-inventory icons, aligned minimap clock, and saved Edit Mode positions for pet/class controls. See the [changelog](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/blob/main/WIIIUIForever/CHANGELOG.txt).

  ![Orc console with refined wood and metal borders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/main/docs/screenshots/orc-theme-borders.png)
  ![Undead console with refined bone borders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/main/docs/screenshots/undead-theme-borders.png)

**[Install](#installation)** · **[Features](#features-at-a-glance)** · **[Customization guide](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md)** · **[Report a bug](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/issues)**

## Features at a glance

| Feature | What it brings |
| --- | --- |
| **Four faction themes** | Human, Orc, Undead, and Night Elf Warcraft III-style consoles. |
| **Movable console boxes** | Reorder or hide the minimap, character panel, action bars, quick slots, and chat; faction borders follow each box. |
| **Full character names** | Optionally show your first name and surname on the HUD and Character window. |
| **Animated portrait** | Character portrait with per-character camera positioning and reset controls. |
| **Native WoW controls** | Action bars, chat, and minimap arranged in the console; a separate Edit Mode layout preserves your previous arrangement. |
| **Custom stat display** | Four selectable slots for damage, armor, ammo, Soul Shards, DPS, crit, spell/healing details, rested XP, and more. |
| **Six quick slots** | An optional item/spell panel that remembers assignments when hidden. |
| **Restyled XP bar** | Level progress, rested segment, and hover details. |
| **Session ribbon** | XP/hour, gold earned, gold/hour, session length, time-to-level estimate, and more, plus an optional day/night clock. |
| **Character and inventory windows** | Four panels for talents, statistics, model/equipment, and inventory, with matching Human, Orc, Forsaken, and Night Elf artwork. |
| **Talent point allocation** | Native tree rows, prerequisites, and ranks; click available talents, then Apply, or Undo all to discard pending changes. |
| **Healing feedback** | Cyan incoming-heal preview and floating green healing-received numbers, with separate per-character toggles. |
| **Combat and PvP indicators** | Configurable indicator styles and visibility; combat statistics use Forever's native damage meter. |

No required companion addons. No MoveAnything or original WIIIUI installation needed.

## See it in action

### The four faction consoles

**Orc — wood, metal, and the spiked chat border**

![Orc console and session ribbon with refined borders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/main/docs/screenshots/orc-theme-borders.png)

**Undead — animated portrait, quick slots, and session ribbon**

![Undead console with quick slots, session ribbon, and refined bone borders](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/main/docs/screenshots/undead-theme-borders.png)

**Human — stone console and day/night ribbon**

![Human console with stone borders and blue session ribbon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/main/docs/screenshots/human-theme-borders.png)

**Night Elf — faction console and ribbon**

![Night Elf console with foliage borders and green session ribbon](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/main/docs/screenshots/night-elf-theme-borders.png)

*The four theme screenshots show the same Night Elf character switching console styles. Character race does not restrict your theme choice. Client world visuals and other addons visible in screenshots are not bundled.*

### Stats and status at a glance

![Character panel showing weapon damage, equipped armor, melee DPS, combat DPS, and numeric health and mana](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/main/docs/screenshots/character-panel-stats.png)

Choose the four stats under your level bar and show health and resources as numbers, percentages, both, or neither.

![Styled PvP-on and idle indicators with icons](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/main/docs/screenshots/pvp-combat-indicators.png)

PvP and combat indicators can use icons, text, or both, with configurable styling and visibility.

### A character sheet worthy of a Warcraft III hero

![Forsaken Kingdom-style character sheet and carried bags](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/main/docs/screenshots/forsaken-character-sheet.png)

Browse talents and statistics beside your model, equipment, and inventory. Drag the Character title bar on any tab; its saved position is shared across tabs. Move the inventory separately. Display all carried bags, the backpack, an individual bag, or no inventory panel.

### Make it your own

![WIIIUI Forever cog configuration menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/main/docs/screenshots/cog-options.png)

Use the **cog above chat** to adjust themes, stat slots, portrait framing, health/resource text, PvP indicators, quick slots, inventory, and the session ribbon. Open **Settings → AddOns → WIIIUI Forever** to reorder or hide console boxes, enable full character names, or report a bug. Detailed controls are in the [configuration guide](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md).

## Installation

1. [Download the 1.1.0 addon ZIP](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/releases/download/v1.1.0/WIIIUIForever-1.1.0.zip) and extract it. For a GitHub source download, click **Code → Download ZIP** and extract the archive.
2. From the extracted archive, copy **only the `WIIIUIForever` folder** into your Forever client's addon directory:

   ```text
   World of Warcraft/
   └── _forever_/
       └── Interface/
           └── AddOns/
               └── WIIIUIForever/
                   ├── WIIIUIForever.toc
                   ├── WIIIUIForever.lua
                   ├── Art.lua
                   └── art/
   ```

3. Restart the game if needed, and enable **WIIIUI Forever** in the AddOn list.
4. Open the **cog above chat** to configure your interface. **Human** is the default theme.

**Important:** Don't copy the whole downloaded repository into `AddOns`; the folder containing `WIIIUIForever.toc` should sit directly inside `AddOns`.

## Quick commands

```text
/wiiiui human
/wiiiui orc
/wiiiui undead
/wiiiui nightelf
/wiiiui off
/wiiiui on
```

Switch to a faction theme using its name. `/wiiiui off` restores the native layout; `/wiiiui on` returns to the console.

Some layout and quick-slot updates are protected during combat and will apply when combat ends.

## Customization details

- **Portrait:** X/Y/Z framing, camera lock, reapply, and reset.
- **Health and resources:** independent numeric, percentage, both, or hidden displays.
- **Healing feedback:** incoming-heal preview after current HP, accounting for missing health and heal absorbs, plus floating healing-received numbers. Toggle separately under **Cog → Health and resource text → Healing feedback**.
- **Talents:** choose a tree in the Character window, click available talents, and **Apply** to learn them; **Undo all** clears pending changes while keeping learned talents. Editing follows native restrictions and is disabled during combat.
- **Stats:** four slots for weapon damage, armor, ammo, weapon DPS, crit, spell/healing info, rested XP, current-fight DPS, or highest-damage ability. Equipment icons are shown where supported.
- **Indicators:** PvP/combat icons, text, both, or hidden; Warcraft/simple frames and inactive visibility options.
- **Quick slots:** drag items or spells to the optional six-slot panel; hiding it retains assignments.
- **Ribbon:** select session metrics, optional faction backing, and Warcraft III day/night clock.
- **Inventory:** choose combined bags, backpack, individual bag, or hide the separate inventory window.

See **[CONFIGURATION.md](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md)** for all settings and how they're saved.

## Supported client and compatibility

1.1.0 targets WoW Forever 1.60.1.71139 / Interface 16001. The build 71139 native UI changes and talent/healing API declarations were reviewed, and Lua regression checks passed; gameplay testing after this game update remains pending. Combat statistics require the native Forever damage meter. Addons that replace or reposition the same native frames can affect the layout; include your addon list when reporting a conflict. Independent positioning of the micro menu and bag-button group is planned for a later patch.

**Found a bug or have an idea?** [Open an issue](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/issues) with:

- Addon version, Forever client version, character race/class, and selected theme.
- Screen resolution, UI scale, and other enabled UI addons.
- Steps to reproduce, expected result, and actual result.
- A screenshot and the first Lua error (if any).
- Whether it happens after login, `/reload`, leveling, combat, or an equipment change.

Contributions are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) or [open a pull request](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/pulls).

## Credits and attribution

Original code is available under the [CC BY 4.0](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/blob/main/LICENSE.md). Third-party artwork and upstream material keep their existing ownership and terms and are excluded from that license.

WIIIUI Forever is a Forever-specific fork and reimagining of **[Fiurs-Hearth/WIIIUI](https://github.com/Fiurs-Hearth/WIIIUI)**. Huge thanks to **Fiur** for the original addon and the faction console foundation. This project has a different implementation and feature set; instructions and dependencies from the upstream project do not necessarily apply.

There are other forks and reimaginings of WIIIUI, including **[Warcraft 3 UI: Forever Edition](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/warcraft-3-ui-forever-edition)** by Infinityaddons. WIIIUI Forever is an optional sidegrade for players who prefer this version's features and layout. Choose whichever version suits you.

Original faction console artwork comes from upstream WIIIUI. Additional Warcraft III artwork was converted from a locally installed game for the Forsaken panels, ribbon, clock, and indicators. See [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/blob/main/CREDITS.md) for asset provenance.

Warcraft, Warcraft III, and World of Warcraft artwork and trademarks belong to Blizzard Entertainment. This is an unofficial community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard.

releases.notes:
# WIIIUI Forever 1.1.0 — Talents and healing feedback

**2026-11-27 · WoW Forever 1.60.1.71139 · Interface 16001**

Includes all changes since 1.0.0. [Download WIIIUI Forever 1.1.0](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/releases/download/v1.1.0/WIIIUIForever-1.1.0.zip).

## Changes

- Allocate talent points in Character → Talents. Trees preserve native rows, empty columns, prerequisite links, rank counts, and availability colours. Click available talents and choose **Apply** to learn them; **Undo all** discards pending changes, including those made in the full talent tree, while preserving learned talents. Native restrictions and combat locks apply.
- Correct Hunter talent coordinates and row offsets, clamp scrolling after refreshes, and check point costs before marking talents available.
- Preview incoming healing as a cyan segment after current HP, clamped to missing health and adjusted for heal absorbs, with the HP text above the bar and the predicted amount above the portrait.
- Show floating green healing-received numbers for self-heals and heals from other players; critical heals use larger text.
- Toggle the two healing displays separately under **Cog → Health and resource text → Healing feedback**. Both default to enabled and save per character.
- Preserve the previous HUD layouts, movable Character/inventory windows, themes, quick slots, Soul Shard tracking, combat statistics, minimap alignment, and Edit Mode positions for class and pet controls.

## Game update review

The installed game executable and build manifest identify **1.60.1.71139**. The matching [native UI source revision](https://github.com/Gethe/wow-ui-source/commit/d9c22e32cb240afb82bb2ecefbb78ef935333f59) changes the shop and gamepad world-map controls. WIIIUI and Record Player do not replace those consumers. Interface remains **16001**, so no TOC interface bump is needed.

The exact-build talent and healing API declarations match the source used for the recent features. WIIIUI's Lua 5.1 parsing and regression checks pass, including all 3,840 HUD layouts, combat deferral, saved positions, talents, healing, quick slots, and combat statistics. Record Player's 36 Python/Lua tests and 13 companion tests also pass. Its installed addon files already match the workspace, so Record Player remains version 0.3.0.

These are source and mocked runtime checks. Gameplay testing on the newly updated client remains pending.

## Install

Extract **WIIIUIForever-1.1.0.zip** and copy its **WIIIUIForever** folder into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`, replacing the previous addon files. Saved settings remain in the game's separate WTF directory. Start the game, or use `/reload` if it is already running.

Check the talent trees and Apply/Undo controls, cast or receive a heal, and confirm the saved HUD layout and class/pet control positions. Record Player and its companion remain separate from the WIIIUI ZIP.

releases.notes:
# WIIIUI Forever V1.0 (1.0.0) — First stable release

**2026-11-25 · WoW Forever 1.60.1 · Interface 16001**

## Changes since Beta V3

- First stable release for World of Warcraft: Forever 1.60.1 (Interface 16001).
- Fixed the six-slot quick inventory: item/spell icons now fit each faction's painted slot interiors, with corrected row spacing and matching click areas, highlights, and cooldowns.
- Corrected minimap sun/moon alignment in all four themes, including the Orc artwork's round recess.
- Includes movable Character windows on every tab, shared saved positions across tabs, independently movable inventory, combat-stat retention, Soul Shard tracking, and custom Edit Mode placement for class/pet controls, pet portraits, and the cast bar.

## Included in V1.0

- Four Warcraft III-inspired themes: Human, Orc, Forsaken/Undead, and Night Elf, with matching Character and inventory artwork.
- Reorder or hide whole HUD sections: minimap, character panel, action bars, six quick slots, and chat. Faction borders follow their positions, with layouts saved per character.
- Four-panel Character window for talents, statistics, model/equipment, and inventory, with title-bar dragging on every tab and a left-side default.
- Inventory views for all carried bags, backpack only, individual bags, or a hidden inventory panel.
- Animated character portrait with per-character framing, camera lock, reset, and reapply controls.
- Optional full character names, including surnames, on the HUD and Character window.
- Four configurable HUD stats with equipment-aware icons, Soul Shards, and Forever's native combat-meter statistics. Cached combat values are identified in their tooltips.
- Separate health/resource text options, XP hover details, and rested-XP progress.
- Six quick slots for dragged items and spells, with saved assignments, counts, and cooldowns.
- Movable class and pet controls through Edit Mode, plus configurable PvP/combat indicators.
- Optional session ribbon with selectable session statistics and a Warcraft III-style day/night clock.
- Square minimap with coordinates, zone/time information, and supported addon buttons arranged above it.
- Shared WIIIUI Forever Bars Edit Mode layout and /wiiiui off to restore the previous native layout.
- Integrated bug-report link in Settings > AddOns > WIIIUI Forever.

## Download and installation

[Download WIIIUI Forever V1.0](https://github.com/Hmimesh/WIIIUIForever/releases/download/v1.0.0/WIIIUIForever-1.0.0.zip)

1. Download **WIIIUIForever-1.0.0.zip** from the release assets.
2. Extract the **WIIIUIForever** folder into `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`, replacing the previous addon files. Existing saved settings remain in WoW's separate WTF directory.
3. Restart the client for a first installation, or type `/reload` after updating.

Choose **Release / Forever 1.60.1** when uploading this ZIP to CurseForge. No companion addons are required. Other WoW clients are not currently tested.

## Configuration

- **Settings > AddOns > WIIIUI Forever:** console layout, full character names, and the bug-report link.
- **Cog above chat:** themes, stat slots, portrait framing, inventory, indicators, and the session ribbon.
- **Esc > Edit Mode > WIIIUI Forever Bars:** move pet/class bars, the pet portrait, and cast bar, then **Save**.
- Drag a Character window title bar on any tab outside combat. The inventory can be moved independently.
- Protected layout changes apply after combat. `/wiiiui off` restores the previous native layout; `/wiiiui on` enables the console.

Independent repositioning of the micro menu and bag-button group is planned for a later patch.
